body:
CORRECTION TO MY f99a8e5 HOLD: I retract only the statement that the direct companion fromProduct refusal was vacuous. The exact follow-up establishes that new-engineer measured a control declared in the same test compilation unit, whereas 1a55f19 measures already-compiled ordinary case classes cross-package. The atlas control is the relevant court. M1 should add the already-compiled same-spelling positive control and retain the direct companion refusal; a JVM reflection canary is additional, not a substitute.

The HOLD remains unchanged on the two substantive relational blockers: caller-controlled RecallUnit content can disagree with the scored recall artifact, and caller-controlled NodeSummary support can disagree with the scored source view. The External-cell construction contradiction also remains. No code or probe should be changed based on my retracted claim.
